acceptance_requires: At least 7200 measured wall-clock seconds and actual executed route/save-restore changes.
Positive source and cached keys prove active GPU preprocessing; positive retired keys after transitions and no stale keys after pruning.
RAM, live allocator allocations, reserved memory and per-device VRAM/GTT evaluated separately across repeated comparable route/camera/weather cycles.
Fresh final screenshot, empty required shader/upload/near-resource queues and bounded fonts, entities and audio.
final_candidate24.known_initial_background_load: Root full-check18 Rust compilation/tests; subsequent release/Snap CPU builds will be recorded. No other viewer uses the integrated GPU.

counter_limitations: Bevy 0.19.1 MaterialBindGroupAllocator::allocations sums allocated_resource_count. Its insert/free paths count repeated bindings of the same newly inserted resource inconsistently. Reusing a texture for base color and emission can leave a positive counter drift after releasing the resource. Raw values are preserved, but this counter alone is not interpreted as live material ownership or proof of a leak. Vulkan allocator allocations/reservations, actual bindings and image/mesh owners remain separate evidence.
A zero bin-unpacking count on a backend without GPU preprocessing does not certify retirement. Candidate24 has positive source/cache keys and positive retired keys after transitions.
